body.condition: The input score is supplied as an explicit finite list \(\sum_{j=1}^r c_j\mathbf 1\{\gamma_j\}\) of raw unnested conjunctions with \(c_j\in\mathbb Q\), and the compiled score uses their deterministic normal forms \(\gamma_j^{\circ}\).

standard.name: Explicit unnesting into finite counterfactual conjunctions
